summary: Phase A SEO on-page test for La Citadelle Numérique. Verified <meta robots noindex,follow> on 6 private/technical pages, and <title>+<meta description>+<link rel=canonical> on 5 legal pages. Also ran non-regression on home + listings, and image alt audit on /citadelle/annonces + /citadelle/blog. All 5 target checks passed. No form submission was performed (respecting Règle 6 / no test emails).

issues: React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be child of <select> / <option>' caused by visual-editor instrumentation wrapping <option> elements inside the SUJETS dropdown (data-ve-dynamic span). Non-blocking, but pollutes console and may cause hydration mismatch in SSR.

private_noindex_follow.notes: All 6 pages emit <meta name=robots content='noindex, follow'>. /reinitialiser-mot-de-passe redirects visually to the forgot-password form when no token is present, but noindex is still applied. /auth/google/callback redirects to login (noindex applied). /paiement/confirmation renders fallback layout (no h1) but noindex applied.

/citadelle/cgu.title: Conditions Générales d'Utilisation | La Citadelle Numérique

/citadelle/cgv.title: Conditions Générales de Vente | La Citadelle Numérique

/citadelle/confidentialite.title: Politique de Confidentialité (RGPD) | La Citadelle Numérique

legal_pages_title_description_canonical.warning: The 5 legal pages all serve the SAME generic default description ('La Citadelle Numérique — Marketplace française d'achat et de vente de sites web, SaaS, boutiques e-commerce et actifs numériques. Transactions sécurisées, estimations professionnelles.'). The request stated 'la meta description spécifique à la page doit exister'. Meta description tags are correctly emitted (so the checkbox is met), but they are NOT page-specific. Recommend adding a distinct <meta name=description> inside each legal page's Helmet block to further reduce 'Crawled - currently not indexed' by increasing content-uniqueness signals. Non-blocking for Phase A acceptance.

no_white_screen_no_crash.notes: All 11 pages under test rendered a non-empty <body> and no react-helmet-async@3.0.0 dynamic <title> crash was reproduced. h1 or equivalent content present on all pages that expose one.

critical_code_review_comments: SeoNoIndex.jsx is clean and DRY. Consider co-locating a <link rel=canonical> alongside noindex on private pages that redirect to a public URL (e.g., /auth/google/callback -> /citadelle/connexion) to consolidate signals.

All 5 legal pages inherit the same generic description from the app-level Helmet. To fully answer the 'Crawled - currently not indexed' issue, define a unique <meta name=description> per legal page (Helmet override) — the current implementation already sets title+canonical uniquely but leaves description identical across the 5 pages.

/citadelle/contact: The visual-editor injects <span> wrappers around <option> children of <select>, causing React hydration console errors. If this affects production, wrap the <select> options rendering to bypass the dynamic instrumentation (or ensure the instrumentation is dev-only).
action_items: OPTIONAL (SEO quality): give each legal page a unique <meta name=description> to avoid duplicate descriptions across 5 URLs (helps with 'Crawled - currently not indexed').
OPTIONAL: silence hydration warning on /citadelle/contact <select><option> caused by visual-editor span injection.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for Phase A acceptance criteria (5/5 checks pass); minor SEO quality improvement suggested

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A SEO wiring is functionally complete: noindex on private pages, title+canonical on legal pages, no react-helmet-async crash. If Phase B introduces per-page unique meta descriptions on legal pages, re-run the same check by inspecting document.querySelector('meta[name=description]').content per URL to confirm uniqueness. Do NOT submit /citadelle/contact or /citadelle/mot-de-passe-oublie forms (Règle 6 — no test emails).
